# Extract survival relevant features

## 1. Differential expression

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
```

## Survival related 

### Mean 

```{r}
rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_1]

rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_2 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("MPO", "CD16", "HLADR", "CD68", "CD163", "CD11c", "CD11b", 
"MMP9", "CCR2", "Arginase", "CD33", "CD209", "CD206", "CD15", "VISTA", "IDO1", "CD274")

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_2)
```

```{r}
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame

out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in colnames(mean_exp_df)){
mean_exp_new <- mean_exp_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(mean_exp_df[[i]])) %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean > mean_exp_df[[i]], "low", "high")) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

out_df[,i] <- mean_exp_new$cat[match(out_df$PID, mean_exp_new$PID)]
}

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
```

```{r}
# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 

#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))

library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,-log10(p)), y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 16))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  facet_grid(~ direction, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

mean_exp_results <- cur_surv_plot
```

```{r}
# UNIVARIATE COX 

## Add covariates 
out_df <- out_df %>% select("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months", everything(.))

for(i in c(4:ncol(out_df))){
  out_df[,i] <- as.factor(out_df[,i])
  out_df[,i] <- relevel(out_df[,i], ref = "low")
}

#Based on proportions
covariates <- out_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,-PID) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = out_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

```{r}
## KM estimate 

# Combined visualization
mean_exp_results$category <- "mean"
median_exp_results$category <- "median"

plot_exp_combined <- rbind(mean_exp_results, median_exp_results)
plot_exp_combined$type <- "expression"
both <- plot_exp_combined %>% group_by(group,direction) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group)
plot_exp_combined$category <- ifelse(plot_exp_combined$group %in% both, "both", plot_exp_combined$category)
plot_exp_combined_fil <- plot_exp_combined %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(p = mean(p), 
                                                                                     result = result, 
                                                                                     type = type, 
                                                                                     ratio = mean(ratio),
                                                                                     direction = direction) %>% unique()

#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/MY_Cox_expression_bubble.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
ggplot(plot_exp_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, shape = category, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_exp_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```


```{r}
## Cox

# Combined visualization in dot plot
cox_median <- plot_df_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)

cox_mean <- plot_df_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)


library(ggnewscale)

ggplot(plot_cox_combined, aes(x=group, y = category,col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_value), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")

plot_cox_combined$type <- "expression"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/MY_cox_expression_bubble.pdf", width = 3, height = 5)
ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p_value), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
dev.off()
```


### Extract survival relevant features

```{r}
# From COX models
#markers_surv_relevant <- c(str_remove(plot_df_median %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "high"), str_remove(plot_df_mean %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "high")) %>% unique()
# From KM models
markers_surv_relevant <- plot_exp_combined_fil$group

# Extract min_max expression values
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce, "min_max") %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(rownames(.) %in% markers_surv_relevant) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

colnames(mean_exp_df) <- paste0("EXP_", colnames(mean_exp_df))
colnames(mean_exp_df)[1] <- "PID"

## Add survival information
myeloid_key_features <- mean_exp_df
myeloid_key_features$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(myeloid_key_features$PID, sce$PID)]
myeloid_key_features$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(myeloid_key_features$PID, sce$PID)]

myeloid_key_features <- myeloid_key_features %>% select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, everything())

# Save
write_csv(myeloid_key_features, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/myeloid_key_features.csv")
```

# 2. Phenotypes

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("MY_", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

```{r}
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),

                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_median <- ggplot(plot_df_median, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+

geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+

geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_median")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_median
```

## Cox - Density 

### Mean 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_myeloid_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_myeloid_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here density of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

#mean division 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

identical(rownames(Cox_df), rownames(Cox_df_mean))

#run the model
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

multi_res$coefficients

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_dens_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_dens_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune myeloid_metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for mean_density")+
theme_classic()+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.01,10))+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_dens_mean
```

## Differential abundance testing 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(factor(sce$myeloid_metacluster)), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between myeloid stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# Filter metaclusters that are differential abundant across at least 2 categories
MC_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score", "necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

DA_out_fil <- DA_out[DA_out$cluster %in% MC_diff_abun, ]

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/MY_diffabun_pheno.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
ggplot(DA_out_fil, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out_fil,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Disease progression")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
multi_res$coefficients
```

## Differential abundance testing 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(factor(sce$myeloid_district_names)), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% names(colSums(abundances))[colSums(abundances) != 0]]

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between myeloid stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# Filter metaclusters that are differential abundant across at least 2 categories
D_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score", "necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

DA_out_fil <- DA_out[DA_out$cluster %in% D_diff_abun, ]
ggplot(DA_out_fil, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out_fil,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Disease progression")
```

```{r}
spicyTest <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/07_comb/spicyTest_ISUP.rds")
```

# Proximity - countInteractions 

```{r}
sce_fil <- sce[,!is.na(sce$celltype_combined)]

count_MY <- countInteractions(sce_fil, 
                  group_by = "sample_id", 
                  label = "celltype_combined", 
                  colPairName = "neighborhood", 
                  method = "interaction")

out <- count_MY
```


## Survival testing 

### Mean 

```{r}
out$cellpair <- paste0(out$from_label, "__", out$to_label)
count_out <- out %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(group_by, cellpair, ct) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cellpair, values_from = ct) %>% as.data.frame()

colnames(count_out) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(count_out)) 
colnames(count_out) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(count_out)) 

count_out <- count_out %>% column_to_rownames("group_by")

## Select from "MY" interactions - All
# selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") |
#   (str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY"))) & (!str_detect(colnames(count_out), "Unknown"))

## Select from "MY" interactions - heterotypic only
selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") &
  (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY"))) & (!str_detect(colnames(count_out), "Unknown"))

count_out_selected <- count_out[,selected_pairs]

count_out_selected <- count_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
count_out_selected$PID <- sce$PID[match(count_out_selected$sample_id, sce$sample_id)]

count_out_selected_long <- count_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(count_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")

# Perform mean interaction score split for all categories 
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in unique(count_out_selected_long$pair)){
count_out_loop <- count_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()

count_out_loop <- count_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(count_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))

out_df[,i] <- count_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, count_out_loop$PID)]
}

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]

# Filter columns with only one entry of high/low
include <- c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months", 
             out_df %>% filter(!is.na(status_OS)) %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months) %>% pivot_longer(1:ncol(.), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())

out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP",
                             #ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    #ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN",NA))#))


# Add info on hetero or homotypic interaction
cur_surv_plot$int_type <- ifelse((str_count(cur_surv_plot$group, "MY") > 1 | str_count(cur_surv_plot$group, "MY") > 1), "homotypic", "heterotypic")

library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,-log10(p)), y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p), shape = int_type))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 16))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  facet_grid(~ direction, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

# Add as result for mean
cur_surv_countInt_results_mean <- cur_surv_plot 
```

# L-cross 

## Survival testing 

### Mean 

```{r}
# Extract spicy output from L function (mean difference across specific radi)
## This is the same for all different comparisons 
spicy_out <- spicyTest$dataframe

#spicy_out <- as.data.frame(do.call("cbind",spicyTest$pairwiseAssoc))
rownames(spicy_out) <- spicy_out$imageID

## Different options for selecting interactions
# A: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells (heterotypic and homtotypic)
selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") |
 (str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY"))) &
 (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown_Other"))

# B: Only select interactions FROM myeloid cells TO non-myeloid cells
# selected_pairs <- str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") &
#  (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(spicy_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY")) &
#  (!str_detect(colnames(spicy_out), "Unknown_Other"))

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out[,selected_pairs]

spicy_out_selected <- spicy_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
spicy_out_selected$PID <- sce$PID[match(spicy_out_selected$sample_id, sce$sample_id)]

spicy_out_selected_long <- spicy_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(spicy_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")

# Perform mean interaction score split for all categories 
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce$PID))

for(i in unique(spicy_out_selected_long$pair)){
spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()

spicy_out_loop <- spicy_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(spicy_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))

out_df[,i] <- spicy_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, spicy_out_loop$PID)]
}

# Filter columns with only one entry of high/low
include <- c("PID",out_df %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(out_df), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())
out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]

## Add survival information 
out_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce$PID)]
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(ratio > 1, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP",
                             #ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    #ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN",NA))#))


# Add info on hetero or homotypic interaction
cur_surv_plot$int_type <- ifelse(str_count(cur_surv_plot$group, "MY") > 1, "homotypic", "heterotypic")

library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,-log10(p)), y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p), shape = int_type))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 16))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  facet_grid(~ direction, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

# Add as result for mean
cur_surv_mean_results <- cur_surv_plot 
```

```{r}
cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique() 

cur_surv$M2CD8 <- out_df$MY_M2_like__CD8_T_cell[match(cur_surv$PID, out_df$PID)]

#Plot specific survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ M2CD8, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization 
cur_surv_mean_results$category <- "mean"
cur_surv_median_results$category <- "median"

plot_int_combined <- rbind(cur_surv_mean_results, cur_surv_median_results)
plot_int_combined$type <- "interaction"
both <- plot_int_combined %>% group_by(group,direction) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group)
plot_int_combined$category <- ifelse(plot_int_combined$group %in% both, "both", plot_int_combined$category)
plot_int_combined_fil <- plot_int_combined %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(p = mean(p), 
                                                                                     result = result, 
                                                                                     type = type, 
                                                                                     int_type = int_type, 
                                                                                     direction = direction) %>% unique()
priority_order <- c("DOWN" = 1, "DOWN_trend" = 2, "UP" = 1, "UP_trend" = 2)
plot_int_combined_fil <- plot_int_combined_fil %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = priority_order[result], with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(plot_int_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,-log10(p)), y = type, col = result, size = -log10(p), shape = category))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  facet_grid(~ direction, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")+
  new_scale("shape")+
  geom_point(data = plot_int_combined_fil, aes(shape = int_type), col = "black")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(4, 3))
```
